label: Post cards
description: The blog's post grid. Its rows come from the Posts screen through the placement's “From Posts” switch, so publishing a post adds a card and nothing here is retyped. Each card carries its topic as a machine key, which is what the filter behaviour's chips match on — never the display copy, which changes. A post with no cover draws an empty placeholder the same size as the photograph, so adding one later does not move the card.

props.label: Message when a topic has no posts
props.default: No posts in this topic yet.

fields.label: Topic — the value a chip matches
